notes.title: Armillo v1.2.4 Released!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We've recently updated Armillo to v1.2.4. It's a minor release to address a few issues.

Fixes are:
- Fixed lives display when a life is lost
- Fixed % calculation on the bonus world
- Gold Achievement fix
- Added VSync option

Keep on rollin'!

notes.title: Armillo v1.2.3 Released!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We've recently updated Armillo to v1.2.3. It is another minor release to address a few issues.

Fixes are:
- Fixed an issue where playing Platformer Level 5-4 plays the wrong level
- Fixed next world transitioning after finishing a new level
- Added a simple loading screen before the splash screen to show that something is going on

Keep on rollin'!

notes.title: Armillo v1.2.2 Released!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We've recently updated Armillo to v1.2.2. It is a minor release to address some game progression issues.

Fixes are:
- Fixed a game freezing bug in World 1-2 for some players when they near the Darkbot Container
- Fixed an issue where playing one of the Platformer Cubes plays the wrong level

Thanks for your support and keep on rollin'!
